purpose: Targeted Ghidra reference census and static contract for the spawn table consumed by 01F7:1AAA.

table.layout: interleaved little-endian words: row[n].x at 8828+4*n and row[n].y at 882A+4*n

writers.calling_convention: near; far resource-row pointer on stack; RET 4; no stable return flags
writers.contract: After resource/map refresh, loops i=0..31 and stores word(resource_word_x(i)+0x20) at row[i].x and word(resource_word_y(i)+0x30) at row[i].y.
writers.resource_selector: 01D7:3861 computes DS:3574 + 5*DS:85D4 as the far source pointer before calling 34C7.

writers.calling_convention: far pooled-object callback; no scheduler return flags
writers.contract: State 10 stores object.x+0x19 at row[0].x and object.y+0x46 at row[0].y, then clears object+0x18.

consumers.contract: Reads row = DS:85D2, promotes row[row].x/y words into the high 16 bits of player +0x02/+0x06, reinstalls callback 3F27, sets +0x29=1, and clears DS:89EA.

static_conclusion: The apparent terminal coordinate pair is row zero of a 32-row spawn table. 34C7 is the code-defined table writer; 8E4B updates row zero; 1AAA consumes the row selected by DS:85D2. All direct code writes found for DS:85D2 reset it to zero. Resource values and any indirect writes remain address-named boundaries.
